decision.reason: [ev-4f1d0d4d568e] is just a one-line PR title from the release's What's Changed list. It doesn't name the component or command where the discard logger is set, and it doesn't say how "debug" is controlled (flag, env var or config). It also doesn't describe the behaviour before and after the fix or what an operator would see. Writing the subject, change, applicability and consequence needs the PR #6274 description or diff, or a release-note entry that describes the fix.
